findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed there to be no paper towels at the handwashing sink closest to the office area. CORRECTED - the PIC placed a new roll of paper towels in the dispenser that stocks this handwashing sink with paper towels. Ensure that all handwashing sinks are stocked with paper towels or another hand drying device at all times during operation and food preparation.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; or (C) A heated-air hand drying device; or (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
Inspectors observed the following surface to be in need of cleaning:
- Internal surface of the coffee dispenser 
- Nozzle of the McFlurry machine
- Nozzle of the soda dispenser in the drive through area

PIC was made aware and PIC instructed an employee to clean and sanitize the surfaces mentioned above. Ensure that all food-contact surfaces are monitored, cleaned and sanitized at all times or at a regular frequency.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
The following physical facilities were observed to be in need of repair.
1. REPEAT- Inspector observed several cracked or broken tiles underneath the soda rack in the basement.
2. Coving on the top stair to the basement was observed to be coming off the step.
3. Leak from the ceiling near the back corner of the lobby area.
4. Caulking on the hand sink by the office is in disrepair

Discussed with PIC, and PIC stated that work orders would be put in for the areas in question. Ensure these areas are repaired to make them smooth, durable, and easily cleanable before your next routine inspection.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed to be standing water on the floor near the mop sink area and dirty water in the mop bucket. The PIC stated it was recently in use and moped up the water to correct the violation. Ensure that mop water is disposed properly after mopping occurs.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.15 Cleaning Maintenance Tools, Preventing Contamination. FOOD preparation sinks, HANDWASHING SINKS, and WAREWASHING EQUIPMENT may not be used for the cleaning of maintenance tools, the preparation or holding of maintenance materials, or the disposal of mop water and similar liquid wastes.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: There was standing water observed near the oil drums in the basement. Discussed with PIC and water is going to be drained to correct the violation. Ensure that all settling water is drained appropriately.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.13(B) Floor and Wall Junctures, Coved, and Enclosed or Sealed. (B) The floors in FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS in which water flush cleaning methods are used shall be provided with drains and be graded to drain, and the floor and wall junctures shall be coved and SEALED.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed multiple employee phones above the food preparation line. PIC was made aware of this and the phones were removed. Ensure that employee belongings are stored in a designated area to prevent contamination of food items.
findings.citation_text: 6-403.11(B) Designated Areas. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be located in a designated room or area where contamination of FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLESERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES can not occur.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the sanitizer bucket at the front of the kitchen to have approximately 10PPM of chlorine sanitizer. Discussed with PIC, and PIC had the sanitizer changed immediately for fresh sanitizer measuring 100PPM of chlorine. Ensure the sanitizers are remade as often as needed to maintain sanitizer levels at or above 50PPM.
findings.citation_text: 4-703.11(C)(2) Hot Water and Chemical. After being cleaned, equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be sanitized in: (C) Chemical manual or mechanical operations, including the application of SANITIZING chemicals by immersion, manual swabbing, brushing, or pressure spraying methods, using a solution as specified under § 4-501.114. Contact times shall be consistent with those on EPAregistered label use instructions by providing: (2) A contact time of at least 7 seconds for a chlorine solution of 50 MG/L that has a PH of 10 or less and a temperature of at least 38°C 100°F) or a PH of 8 or less and a temperature of at least 24°C (75°F).

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment: Inspector observed there to be a build-up of ice in the WIF. The ice in the WIF is all over the ceiling in frozen droplets. Discussed cleaning out the ice with PIC. Ice build-up of this fashion could indicate a problem with the unit. Ensure that the ice is removed from the ceiling often enough to make the surface nonabsorbent and smooth.
findings.citation_text: 4-101.19 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed several cracked or broken tiles underneath the soda rack in the basement. Discussed with PIC, and PIC stated that a work request would be put in. Ensure these areas are repaired to make them smooth, durable, and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.
